Improved player stun time is now reduced to get you back into the fight quicker, you can use dodge to get up straight away.
Improved reflections, they now have far less distortion issues.
Adjusted Tyler's starting position to make him easier to tag.
Improved path finding enemies won't get stuck behind breakable objects under overhangs.
Fixed mirrors not breaking.
Fixed some stages windows would break, but then appear non broken when entering a building.
Fixed issue where sometimes enemies would not get stunned correct when hit (for example if the enemy was taking a weapon out)
Fixed issue where some enemies would get stuck not attacking you.
Fixed issue where some enemies would get stuck waiting for your character to recover even though you already had.

Fixed issue in Chapter 3-2 with slowdown after defeating the first 3 enemies and then restarting multiple times.

Fixed toilets sit-able.

Added 2 new Stages 3 - 9 and 3 - 10.

Improved Byron's muscle definition and adjusted colours to make his features and details pop a little.
Improved Pathfinding when enemies are close to walls and have to move behind walls or into buildings.
Improved Ragdolls v3
Ragdolls now fall at more consistent speeds
Ragdolls tangle far less frequently and resolve far quicker
Ragdolls get stuck in the environment far less frequently and resolve far quicker
Update: Control settings will now save if you update your controls
Update: Display and sound
Cutscene System updated to be more consistent
Fix: Enemies and players can no longer pickup and hold weapons after they break (sometimes they would get picked up broken and the character would walk around with nothing in their hands)
Fix: Hitting certain stage areas with weapons would cause your character to freeze
Fix: Sometimes your ragdoll doesn't disable correctly and you end up walking around colliding into scenary and weapons.
Fix: When NPC's leave the stage they would leave their weapons behind.
Fix: bug when enemies would be interacting (stuck in blender or car window) and would then begin to fly around the screen.
Fix: issue where sometimes breakable items would stop the pathfinding of an enemy as they would think they could walk through it.
Fix: The Wraiths Office would scroll the view too high and you would not be able to see :( Thanks to memeguy101 and Rise for the Emblem
Fix: Sometimes you would land on weapons mid air.
Fix: Issue with Stage Music not fading out if you had changed the volume of the game music.
Fix: Being awarded Achievement for completing a stage on Normal and Hard, only Hard should have counted.

Pending: Difficulty was reported not to be working, I can't recreate this, but it may have been a bug I have inadvertently fixed... so I will keep my eye on it. Let me know if you get any issues with it!
Thanks to "Rise for the Emblem" for reporting an issue with the Wraiths office via video.

Sorry for the delay to chapter 4, this is coming I've had some person issues I need to attend to and also needed to order additional dev kits to test some new features and it's taking longer than anticipated. I hope to have everything ready by mid next month latest.
With chapter 4 being the last chapter I want to make sure everything is perfect!
Jon

Apologies everyone, but there has been a slight delay to Chapter 3, due to me wanting to add more content! But here is a pre - chapter 3 update that includes a lot of fixes and some new stuff too! If all goes to plan it will drop March 24th.
Here is what is added in this update.
Added Arcade Mode - Select a single chapter to play all the way through.
Improved font resolution and readability.
Added save and load notifications during auto save and load.
New rendering style makes the whole game a little more stylish and retro.
Disable Scanlines
Turn off Gore
Improved Ragdoll stability when knocking enemies that are overlapping.
Fixed issues on 4 player where player 4 would get stuck trying to get to the start point.
Fixed issue with some trophies not registering.
Fixed minor issue with some stages loading a little slower.
Correct "an" to "a" in "You are a Vigilante"
Added Damage as a Stat (Please note this does not affect you hero status, so feel free to smash things up!)
Fixed issue with characters bouncing when walking up stairs.
Fixed Tag in bug after you die.
Improved Ragdoll stability when thrown close to walls or knocked close to walls.
Falling enemies are now far more dynamic
Fixed issue where Simon would sometimes be given full health (sorry).
Fixed: Some objects had a dynamic mesh, causing performances issues on some devices.
Fixed: Character would sometimes try to throw themselves.
Fixed: Sometimes enemies get stuck attacking characters that have left the stage.
Update Final Status now shows as Police Status and the following status have been updated to make them more clear.
Hero
Anti-Hero -> Vigilante
Villain -> Criminal
Stage 1-3
Fixed: Pieces of Consoles were glowing... maybe they were radioactive.
Stage 1-3
Fixed: Pub wall hide trigger firing when you are not inside sometimes (far right wall)
Stage 1-4
Fixed: Top wall shadow is weird
Stage 2-1
Fixed: Far background is black when multiplayer characters move really far apart.
Stage 2-4
Fixed: Stricklands house not hiding correctly when you enter it.
Fixed: Stricklands house not hiding correctly when you walk down the side or the back.
Jon

items.text: Chapter 2 Patch 2.2
This patch contains more than 60 additional features, fixes and improvements.
General
Fixed Tyler throws not working.
Fixed unlock icon for Tyler when you unlock him.
Fixed issue with enemy gang status not resetting on creating a new game.
Fixed issues with some shards rendering wrong and causing performance issues.
Car - Rear Bumper corrected hold angle.
Car - Rear Bumper Mini corrected hold angle.
Closing cut scenes not showing through story.
Improved pathfinding around dynamic objects blocking enemies.
Fixed issue with thrown enemies sometimes performing an animation and floating off.
Fixed issue with enemies not getting stunned correctly if they were currently performing an interaction (such as taking out or picking up a weapon)

Increased speed of attacking switching (When you do a back attack in the middle of a combo, and then switch back to a front attack) this is now much much faster, it might be a little overpowered but, it feels much more responsive.
House Windows glowing in some scenes and missing colliders.
Mina hurt sounds incorrect
Fixed issue with Jumping when downed facing the wrong way
Prioritize grabbing enemies if standing on an item during a combo, please note this only applies if the next move is a link throw.
Fixed issues with doors hiding wrong on the houses.
Fixed issue with windows not smashing on the houses.
Fixed deck small upright between rails breaking incorrectly and held wrong
Fixed wooden door breaking, smaller pieces held wrong.
Characters would react to themselves performing actions sometimes causes them to focus on themselves which resulted in them rapidly turning left and right.
Fixed issue with severed limbs rendering in the wrong location.
Fixed issue with severed limbs not severing in place (sometimes they would jump from the enemies falling position to a new spot).
Fixed path finding issue where enemies would sometimes run to stage start after knocking down their opponent.
Fixed path finding issue when enemies would get stuck inside something (walls or other solid objects)
OpenGL Render Issues
Fixed bug with Characters not rendering on some older devices.
Fixed blood and other particles not rendering on some older devices.
Fixed blurry textures on some older devices.
All graphics devices
Fixed some textures blurry at angles.

You can now cancel attacks by dodging.
Dodge responds better to slightly early button presses (if you press dodge before you land from a jump for example).
Dodge will instantly occur when getting up.
Attacks can't hit player during the dodge (only while the player is actively moving)
Improved ragdolls even more, they should not trigger to early during throws anymore due to hitting certain objects.
Improved ragdolls when throwing an enemy that overlaps another enemy.
Players can no longer be hit during throws while they are actively holding and throwing an enemy.

Explosions now throw characters into the air... which is hillarious.

Thanks to everyone who helped find and report these issues I appreciate it and special thanks to Mr.Din for his helpful suggestions.

items.text: Chapter 3 Patch 1 - Improved Fun
Added new playable character Arthur, Zimmer Fu expert.
Improved enemy path finding when enemies or the player are on different floors.

Massive improvement to Ragdolls, should shop
Improved enemy AI, they will not try and change attack sides if they are too close, which fixes issues with them ending up completely over you.
Increased close attack range to cover situations when an enemy is over you or very close.
Fixed Ragdoll glitching when the falling enemy failed to fully ragdoll due to the character incorrectly attempting to return to a stance.
Fixed Ragdoll glitching when the falling enemy failed to fully ragdoll due to the character velocity check incorrectly using the velocity of the limb rather than the central moving body.
Adjusted character recovery, ragdolled characters would sometimes stop mid fall to recover now they will recover while falling.
Fixed issue with the Wraiths hair not animating correctly
Fixed issue with Pennys hair not animating correctly
Fixed issue with hair sometimes making characters fall funny
Fixed issue with body colliders not quite being aligned correctly
Fixed Vin doing reduced damage compared to other characters
Fixed Characters looking up for no reason on balconies.
